reasons.held: Held until sending can start again.
reasons.sent_fallback: Sent as plain text, because the button was refused.
reasons.unknown: We didn’t get a confirmation, so it won’t be resent.
reasons.expired: It waited too long and was dropped.
reasons.skipped: We chose not to send this.
reasons.would_send: Dry run: this would have been sent.
reasons.webhook.bad_signature: A message claiming to be from Meta failed its security check.
reasons.webhook.duplicate: Meta told us about this twice. It was handled once.
reasons.webhook.malformed: Meta sent something we couldn’t read.
reasons.tenant.unknown_entry: This came for an account that isn’t connected.
reasons.api.host_blocked: A call to an address that isn’t Meta’s was stopped.
reasons.unmapped: No automation is set up for this post.
reasons.no_keyword: The comment didn’t have one of the keywords.
reasons.own_thread: This was a reply under your own comment.
reasons.unsupported_media: Comments on ads and Live aren’t answered.
reasons.test_mode: This automation is in Test, and the person isn’t a tester.
reasons.automation.draft: This automation is still a draft.
reasons.outside_hours: This came in outside the automation’s hours.
reasons.too_short: The comment was too short to act on.
reasons.optout: This person asked not to get automated messages.
reasons.negative_intent: The comment read like a complaint, so no sales link went out.
reasons.window.closed: It has been more than 24 hours since this person last messaged you.
reasons.expired.7d: A private reply is only allowed within 7 days of the comment.
reasons.expired.public_reply: The public reply waited too long to be useful.
reasons.followup.no_response: A follow-up only goes after the person has replied.
reasons.mention.no_window: A mention on its own doesn’t allow a DM.
reasons.tag.not_allowed: That kind of message isn’t allowed outside the 24-hour window.
reasons.thread.handoff: The person asked for a human, so automation stopped in this chat.
reasons.thread.owner_replied: You replied yourself, so automation stopped in this chat.
reasons.comment.deleted: The comment was deleted before the reply went out.
reasons.comment.edited: The comment was edited, so it no longer asks for this.
reasons.cap.per_comment: This comment already got its one reply.
reasons.cap.per_media: This person was already sent a DM for this post.
reasons.cap.per_person_24h: This person reached the daily limit of DMs.
reasons.cap.mention_7d: This person was already sent a DM for a mention this week.
reasons.cap.followup: This person was already sent a follow-up for this automation.
reasons.cap.welcome_once: This person was already sent the welcome message.
reasons.cap.reply_per_message: This message was already answered automatically.
reasons.cap.dm_replies_24h: This person reached the daily limit of automated replies.
reasons.cap.public_reply_media_h: This post reached its hourly limit of public replies.
reasons.cap.public_reply_tenant_h: Your account reached its hourly limit of public replies.
reasons.content.too_long: The message is over the length limit.
reasons.content.financial_request: The message asked for card, bank or identity details.
reasons.content.button_title: The button text is over the limit.
reasons.content.bad_variable: The message used a variable that doesn’t exist.
reasons.content.bhava_promo: The message named or linked to the platform that sends it.
reasons.link.scheme: The link has to start with https.
reasons.link.shortener: Short links that hide the destination aren’t allowed.
reasons.link.not_allowlisted: That website isn’t allowed for this link type.
reasons.link.redirect: The link sends people somewhere else first.
reasons.link.check_failed: The link didn’t open when we checked it.
reasons.rate.throttled: Instagram asked us to slow down, so this is waiting.
reasons.rate.usage_header: Your account is close to Instagram’s limit, so this is waiting.
reasons.rate.slow_mode: Slow mode was on, so this waited.
reasons.fallback.validation: The button was refused, so plain text went instead.
reasons.send.unknown_outcome: We didn’t get a confirmation, so it won’t be resent.
reasons.paused.global: Bhava paused all messages for a while.
reasons.paused.breaker: Sending stopped by itself after errors from Instagram.
reasons.held.dm_limit: Your plan’s monthly DM limit was reached.
reasons.cancelled.optout: The person opted out before it went.
reasons.token.refresh_failed: Your Instagram connection couldn’t be renewed.
reasons.token.deauthorized: The connection was removed from Instagram.
reasons.gate.access_level: Meta hasn’t given this account access yet.
reasons.gate.scope_missing: A permission is missing from your connection.
reasons.gate.privacy_url: The privacy page failed its check.
reasons.gate.deletion_callback: The data deletion address failed its check.
reasons.deletion.requested: A person asked for their data to be deleted.
reasons.ai.low_confidence: The AI wasn’t sure, so it didn’t answer.
reasons.ai.ungrounded: The AI had nothing to base an answer on.
reasons.wa.no_optin: This person hasn’t opted in on WhatsApp.
